run_contrastive_excitation_backprop: run contrastive excitation backprop on a model to compute saliency maps for a given category
get_example_data: get example benchmark data including a model, input tensor, and category ID
plot_example: plot an input image alongside its computed saliency map with a title
compute_saliency_map: compute a saliency map using contrastive excitation backprop with specified saliency and contrast layers
analyze_model_attribution: analyze model attribution by running contrastive excitation backprop and plotting the results
